transcript.text: I see this as a really huge problem for
a lot of small business owners. I'll
talk to, you know, a small business
owner and say, "Hey, you know, I hired a
salesperson and then it it didn't work
out." And I'm like, "Cool. So, what'd
you learn from that?" Well, no one can
sell like I can sell. I'll be like,
"Well, I think you might have learned
the wrong lesson from the mistake." The
only thing worse than wrong like than
having the mistake is learning the wrong
lesson from the mistake because then
you're bound to repeat it again. I
actually see this happen a lot. I think
it's one of the most common mistakes
that happens in entrepreneurship is that
people just extrapolate their current
view of the world over the mistake.
Fundamentally, the people who are better
at business see business more clearly.
